prediction.model: LightGBM on physics features + Sightglass rationale engine
prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 52.1 °C (68% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 58.3 °C (50% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 56.6 °C (57% above healthy). Thermal equilibrium is compromised, causing fluid temperature to rise well above nominal operating limits.
Valve: severe lag. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.70 s (within 1% of healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.57 s (3% above healthy). Substantial delay in circuit pressurization confirms delayed spool actuation in the main valve.
Pump leakage: weak leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 3.32 l/min (49% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 790 W·min/l (106% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 30.8 % (48% below healthy). Slight elevation in power-to-flow ratio reflects incipient volumetric efficiency loss.
Accumulator: slightly reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 57.0 bar (22% above healthy). Hydraulic dampening shows early wear with mildly heightened ripple during load transitions.
